lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.quote: A **simple sentence** has one independent clause and no dependent clause.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.note: The banned table is gone. Counts are written as words without bare numerals.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.quote: A **compound sentence** has at least two independent clauses and no dependent clause.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.note: The banned table is gone. Counts are written as words without bare numerals.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.quote: A **complex sentence** has one independent clause and at least one dependent clause.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.note: The banned table is gone. Counts are written as words without bare numerals.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.quote: A **compound-complex sentence** has at least two independent clauses and at least one dependent clause.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.note: The banned table is gone. Counts are written as words without bare numerals.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.quote: *Prepared and rehearsed* share that subject. They stay in the same clause.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.note: The dense parenthetical explanation is split into short numbered steps.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.quote: A **clause** is a group of words with a subject and a verb.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.note: Clause and both clause types are defined before sentence structures.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.quote: Check that the word introduces a clause with its own subject and verb.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-sentence-st.note: The shortcut now states its condition and gives since Monday as a counterexample.

language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.quote: Salungat sa inaasahan ang pagkahuli matapos umalis nang maaga. Piliin ang *ngunit*.

language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.quote: Ang pagbaha ang dahilan ng pagsasara. Piliin ang *dahil*.

language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.quote: Kasunod ang pagpasa, kaya gamitin ang *pagkatapos*.
language-proficiency-grammar-and-structu.note: Example #9 selects opening, next-event, and final-event markers with reasons.
